verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI's own API layers AI analysis (summarization, sentiment, topic detection) on top of a user's transcripts. Its LLM Gateway applies frontier models to that data, for example to generate structured meeting notes, so AI insight from the user's data is a first-party capability. The evidence only shows this through the API, though, and never shows proactive suggestions or an in-product insights surface. Missing for 10: documented AI-generated suggestions or recommendations, an in-dashboard or Playground insights experience, independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Layers speech analysis on top of transcripts — summarization, sentiment, topic detection, and more over audio — for extracting structured insight.
Gives unified access to frontier language models through the same API, so teams can apply reasoning models to their transcription without a separate integration.
generate structured meeting notes with LLM Gateway
